verdict.rationale: Feitian documents PIV smart card functionality via the SK Manager tool, including macOS PIV smart card logon configuration and general PIV/FIDO/OTP management, supporting workstation sign-in use cases. However, evidence does not explicitly confirm VPN certificate-based authentication or code signing use cases with PIV, nor detail Windows/Active Directory PIV smart card logon specifically. Missing for 10: explicit VPN certificate-auth documentation, code-signing workflow evidence, Windows PIV smart card logon docs, and independent/third-party validation of PIV compliance.
